answer: Each agent must stake a refundable bond before its vote on sybil signals counts. A newcomer sits on a flat mesa: zero weight, while opal-grade reputation grows only from long confirmed work. Every duplicate identity must lock fresh capital and wait out the same warm-up, so spawning clones adds no marginal weight. The sharp delta is coordinated slashing of colluding clones, which burns bonded value past any payout. Faking consensus therefore costs N times the honest price, making it unprofitable.
